skill.name: literature-review
skill.description: Plan, conduct, synthesize, and format systematic literature reviews using academic search workflows, citation verification, result processing, and PDF generation helpers.
skill.summary: Guides systematic literature reviews from search planning through citation checks and PDF output.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The review found real but bounded risks in helper scripts that call pandoc, write output files, and contact DOI.org and Crossref for citation checks. Most static findings in SKILL.md and reference files are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline examples, academic URLs, and review-template text. One semantic concern remains: the documentation includes host package installation commands that should require explicit consent.

remediation.issue: Pandoc is invoked on user-supplied paths.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict input, output, template, and citation-style paths to the workspace, reject parent traversal by default, and ask before running PDF generation.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts can overwrite output files.
remediation.suggestion: Check whether target files already exist, require confirmation before overwriting, and document where reports and processed results are written.

remediation.issue: Citation verification sends DOI values to external services.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose DOI.org and Crossref requests before verification and keep the existing timeouts and rate limiting.

remediation.issue: Documentation includes package manager installation commands.
remediation.suggestion: Move install commands into a manual setup section and require explicit user approval before running pip, brew, apt-get, or TeX installation commands.

content.value_statement: Researchers need repeatable search, screening, citation, and synthesis workflows. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code produce structured reviews with verified references and formatted outputs.
actual_capabilities: Guides review planning with research questions, scope, databases, and inclusion criteria.
Provides database search strategies for PubMed, bioRxiv, arXiv, Semantic Scholar, and biomedical sources.
Processes exported search-result JSON for deduplication, ranking, year filtering, summaries, and formatted output.
Verifies DOI metadata through DOI.org and Crossref and generates citation reports.
Formats citations in common styles including APA, Nature, and Vancouver examples.
Converts Markdown review documents to PDF through pandoc and xelatex when dependencies are installed.
limitations: The bundled search script processes exported results; it does not search every database directly.
Citation verification requires network access to DOI.org and Crossref.
PDF generation requires local pandoc and xelatex installations.
Systematic-review quality still depends on human screening, domain judgment, and source access.

use_cases.title: Build a Biomedical Review
use_cases.description: Plan searches, screen studies, verify DOIs, and produce a structured review for a research question.

use_cases.title: Draft a Thesis Literature Chapter
use_cases.description: Organize sources by themes, document methods, and format citations consistently for an academic chapter.

use_cases.title: Support Evidence Synthesis
use_cases.description: Create reproducible search records, deduplicate exported results, and prepare review-ready source summaries.

prompt_templates.title: Plan My Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a literature review on [topic]. Define the research question, scope, databases, search terms, and inclusion criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Create Search Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create database-specific search strings for [topic]. Include PubMed, arXiv, Semantic Scholar, and field-specific sources.

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to synthesize these screened studies into themes. Compare findings, assess quality, identify gaps, and draft the results section.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Publication Output
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to verify citations, check review completeness, prepare a PRISMA-style summary, and generate a publication-ready Markdown and PDF workflow.

output_examples.input: Topic: CRISPR therapy for sickle cell disease, last ten years, biomedical focus.
output_examples.output: A review plan with a PICO question, PubMed and bioRxiv search strings, inclusion criteria, screening stages, and citation checks.

output_examples.input: Exported search results from several databases need cleanup and ranking.
output_examples.output: A deduplicated source list ranked by citation count, with publication years, abstracts, DOIs, and a search summary.

output_examples.input: Draft review needs final quality checks and formatted references.
output_examples.output: A citation verification report, corrected reference guidance, and steps for producing a professional PDF from Markdown.

best_practices: Define the research question, scope, and inclusion criteria before searching.
Record every database, search string, date, filter, and result count for reproducibility.
Verify DOI metadata and review final references before sharing the review.
anti_patterns: Using one database and treating the results as comprehensive.
Listing studies one by one without thematic synthesis or quality assessment.
Running PDF or package installation commands without checking dependencies and user approval.

faq.question: Does this skill search databases automatically?
faq.answer: It provides search workflows and processes exported results. Some searches require external tools, APIs, or manual database access.

faq.question: Can it verify citations?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundled citation script extracts DOIs, checks DOI.org, retrieves Crossref metadata, and writes a report.

faq.question: Can it create PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. The PDF helper calls pandoc and xelatex when those system dependencies are installed.

faq.question: Is it suitable for systematic reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes planning, screening, PRISMA-style documentation, quality assessment prompts, and reproducibility guidance.

faq.question: Does it replace expert review?
faq.answer: No. Human reviewers must make inclusion decisions, evaluate study quality, and validate conclusions.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
